caption: Honda Lease Trust v. Malanga’s Automotive
citation_line: Honda Lease Trust v. Malanga’s Automotive, No. 24-2369 (3d Cir. Sept. 15, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Hayden entered summary judgment against a vehicle lessor’s due-process, unreasonable-seizure, and takings claims after a municipal towing contractor held a leased car for nearly a year without notifying the lessor.
qualification_rationale: The case provides significant constitutional guidance for municipalities, towing companies, vehicle owners, and secured or leasing interests concerning notice and process when an impounded vehicle accrues storage charges.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in part and reversed in part in a precedential opinion. It held that the municipal policies violated procedural due process while rejecting the Fourth Amendment and takings claims.
subject_label: Procedural Due Process and Vehicle Impoundment
